summary: Inferno Maw is the deepest molten chamber of the Plane of Fire. Lava flows converge into a massive elemental throat that consumes heat, flame, and molten stone.
history: Formed during the first eruption of the elemental core.
Molten flows carved the Maw’s caverns over millennia.
Firestorm entities emerged from the pressure wells.
The Maw of Flame arose as the apex predator of the molten depths.
